fusions.name: Trampling Landing
fusions.desc: A crashing landing deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles. Its damage rises +3% per 100 paces run since you last used it (max +30%).

fusions.name: Drumming Cuffs
fusions.desc: A cuff that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after using it. You hold 5 charges and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Racing Pulse
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 7 tiles forward. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Roadwise
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your dodge chance rises by 10%. Your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.
